caption: The drawing features two main objects placed on a light, off-white background. On the left side, there is a detailed depiction of an iron branding iron with a handle and a looping circular grip at one end. The branding end of the iron is shaped into a stylized capital letter "A," with decorative curves and extended feet at the bottom of the legs of the "A." The metal is rendered in shades of dark gray, brown, and slight hints of blue and maroon, giving the appearance of aged or used iron. To the right of the branding iron, there is a simple drawing of the same stylized "A" in a reddish-brown color, representing the mark made by the branding iron. Both objects are clearly spaced apart, with the branding iron positioned diagonally from the upper right to the lower left, and the branded "A" mark situated vertically and slightly to the right. The artist’s signature, "Elizabeth Johnson," appears in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Branding Iron
